decision.description: 'relay' when the follow-up message is a continuation of the linked task and belongs on that GitHub issue; 'skip' when it is a new task, unrelated, or merely conversational.

confidence.description: Confidence in the decision, from 0.0 (no confidence) to 1.0 (certain). A 'relay' decision below the caller's threshold is treated as 'skip'.

rationale.description: Brief explanation naming the specific overlap or mismatch between the follow-up message and the linked task.
